decks.notes: This deck focuses on quickly casting spells with cascade abilities to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays. The key strategy is to utilize cards like Violent Outburst and Shardless Agent to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury. By leveraging cascade mechanics and efficient spells, the deck aims to generate advantage and pressure the opponent early in the game. Additionally, cards like Leyline Binding and Force of Negation provide disruption and protection to ensure the deck can execute its game plan effectively.

This deck focuses on utilizing Indomitable Creativity to cheat powerful creatures onto the battlefield, utilizing Leyline Binding to control the opponent's creatures, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to copy spells and create powerful synergies. The deck also includes a variety of versatile spells like Prismari Command, Fire / Ice, and Persist to control the game and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's color requirements and maximize consistency. This deck thrives on creativity and combo potential to outmaneuver opponents and secure victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of Elementals and control spells to disrupt the opponent's strategy. It utilizes powerful cards like Yorion, Sky Nomad, Wrenn and Six, and Omnath, Locus of Creation to generate value and maintain board presence. The deck also includes cards like Solitude and Prismatic Ending to deal with threats efficiently. With a mix of ramp, card draw, and disruption, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent while keeping them on the back foot until it can establish a dominant position and win the game.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and aggressively cast spells with Cascade mechanics to generate value and swarm the opponent with threats. By using cards like Shardless Agent and Violent Outburst to cascade into powerful spells like Crashing Footfalls and Fury, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and keep up the pressure. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Subtlety helps protect the game plan while cards like Brazen Borrower provide additional tempo plays. Overall, the goal is to outpace the opponent and win through a combination of speed and efficiency.

The deck aims to quickly assemble the key cards, like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Urza's Saga, to generate powerful mana ramp and recursion effects. By utilizing lands like bouncing lands, Valakut, and Tolaria West, the deck can quickly search for and play important utility lands like Vesuva and Bojuka Bog. The goal is to efficiently tutor for and play Primeval Titan to search for lands and create a powerful board state, ultimately overwhelming the opponent with high-value land drops and creature summons.

This Modern Aggro deck is focused on dealing fast and consistent damage to the opponent using efficient burn spells and aggressive creatures. With a low mana curve and plenty of direct damage spells like Skewer the Critics, Lightning Bolt, and Lava Spike, the deck aims to quickly reduce the opponent's life total while also using creatures like Goblin Guide and Monastery Swiftspear to apply pressure. The deck also includes cards like Eidolon of the Great Revel and Searing Blaze to disrupt the opponent's game plan and maintain control of the battlefield.

This Jund aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays backed up by efficient removal spells and disruption to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early and maintain control of the board through a combination of versatile removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push, hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Inquisition of Kozilek, and powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Chandra, Torch of Defiance. The deck seeks to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and versatile game plan that can adapt to various board states.

The main concept of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent early with aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, while also utilizing cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Tourach, Dread Cantor to further disrupt the opponent's hand and board. The deck also includes powerful threats like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to close out the game quickly. Additionally, cards like Dauthi Voidwalker and Fury provide additional disruption and versatility to the deck.

This deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and powerful cascade spells. By casting cards like Crashing Footfalls and Violent Outburst, the deck can quickly generate a board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan. Utilizing cards like Teferi, Time Raveler and Force of Negation helps to control the game and protect key threats. The inclusion of Shardless Agent and Omnath, Locus of Creation gives the deck versatility and additional win conditions. Overall, this deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent while maintaining control of the game.

This deck revolves around utilizing cascade mechanics to quickly generate threats on the board while disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and tempo plays. By cascading into powerful cards like Crashing Footfalls and Omnath, Locus of Creation, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with quick and efficient aggression. The inclusion of cards like Force of Negation and Teferi, Time Raveler provide additional disruption and protection, allowing the deck to maintain its aggressive advantage. Additionally, the companion Yorion, Sky Nomad provides extra value and consistency through its flicker effect.

The deck focuses on using cards like Wrenn and Six, Indomitable Creativity, and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to create powerful combo plays and outmaneuver the opponent. The deck includes control elements like Spell Pierce and Prismari Command to protect the combo pieces and disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of creatures like Archon of Cruelty and burn spells like Lightning Bolt provide additional win conditions. Cards like Leyline Binding and Teferi, Time Raveler help to control the board and maintain advantage. Overall, the deck emphasizes creative plays and strategic thinking to achieve victory.

The deck focuses on using Cascade mechanics to quickly and efficiently cast powerful spells for free, overwhelming the opponent with a combination of creatures and spells. By including Yorion, Sky Nomad as a companion, the deck can generate additional value and make it harder for opponents to keep up. The deck also includes a variety of lands to ensure mana consistency and a mix of control elements to protect and support the aggressive game plan. Overall, the deck aims to be fast, proactive, and disruptive in order to secure a swift victory.

This deck focuses on quickly flooding the board with creatures and using cards like Ephemerate and Soulherder to gain card advantage and disrupt the opponent's strategy. With a mix of powerful creatures like Ice-Fang Coatl and Solitude, along with efficient mana ramp from Noble Hierarch, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive attacks and disruptive plays. The deck also includes cards like Collected Company to provide additional creature threats and utility. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Time Warp and Endurance provide additional flexibility and disruption options.

The deck focuses on aggressive play style using a combination of cheap creatures and sacrifice effects to deal damage quickly. It utilizes cards that allow for efficient card draw and graveyard recursion to maintain pressure on the opponent. The inclusion of synergistic cards like Goblin Bombardment and Mayhem Devil enhances the direct damage potential of the deck. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, allowing for the aggressive game plan to be executed effectively. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a relentless onslaught of creatures and burn damage.

The deck focuses on aggressive Rakdos cards that disrupt the opponent's hand and graveyard while utilizing efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dauthi Voidwalker. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon can disrupt opponents' mana bases, while cards like Grief and Thoughtseize help strip away key cards from the opponent's hand. Feign Death and Undying Malice provide ways to protect your important creatures, while Seasoned Pyromancer helps generate card advantage. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and disrupt your opponent's game plan to secure a quick victory.

This deck focuses on assembling a powerful combo by using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to quickly deal massive damage to the opponent. By tutoring for these key pieces with Stoneforge Mystic and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to create explosive turns that can catch the opponent off guard. With support from cards like Esper Sentinel and Giver of Runes for protection, the deck aims to win the game swiftly and decisively before the opponent can respond.
